thesis: Counterevidence challenges universal selfishness and the narrators claim to superior disinterest without denying exploitation.

ideas.statement: Stranger kidney donation challenges impossible purity standards; mixed motives do not erase real help or prove a wholly good world.
Haidt, Bandura and Sie complicate rationalization and experimental interpretation; the narrator published only respectable reasons for leaving Mara.
Sanctions can target high contributors; bounded experiments and models demand scrutiny of appeals and objections, not automatic martyr status.
Cynical genius findings undermine distrust as intelligence; calibrate expectations, include uneventful cooperation and distinguish wallet contact from recovery.
